messages:
kevin: Quick alert — saw ~1% token undercount for several EU tenants yesterday, investigating.

sam: which stage? ingest, agg, or finalizer?

kevin: aggregator TTL dropped events that landed after the hourly watermark. suspect host clock skew during a rolling deploy.

nisha: can you paste a sample?

kevin: ```event_id: b7c9...
tenant: eu-14
source_ts: 2025-11-18T21:59:10Z
ingest_ts: 2025-11-18T22:00:45Z
action: ttl_evict
```

tony: allowed_lateness is 30s today; infra hosts spiked to 60-90s during restart.

marta: mitigation options: bump allowed_lateness for EU, or accept late events into a late_lane and emit late_token events for reconciliation.

sam: prefer late_lane + reconciler dry-run to avoid increasing state retention cluster-wide.

kevin: proposed short plan: 1) set allowed_lateness=120s for EU ingest shards (temporary), 2) aggregator emits billing_event type=late_token for late but accepted events, 3) run reconciler dry-run that writes candidate compensations to s3 and exposes a draft in Invoice Preview.

billing-bot: metrics posted: invoice_delta_rate = `sum(delta_charge)/sum(expected_charge)` over 1h; late_token_count = `sum(billing_events{type="late_token",region="eu"})`. Dashboards -> Billing > Late-Arrivals. :white_check_mark:

ops: maintenance window ok 2025-11-20T09:00Z-11:00Z, will monitor.

nisha: I'll own reconciler dry-run. Implementation notes: idempotency key = sha256(event_id + tenant + source_ts), feature flag `reconciler.apply_compensations` default=false, dry-run CSV to s3://billing-previews/late-arrivals/{run_ts}/preview.csv.

marta: UI: add Invoice Preview toggle "Include late-arrivals (canary)" and mark any suggestions as draft with tag `late-arrivals-suggested`. CS review required before apply.

sam: I'll DM canary tenants (low-risk EU test customers). Alert: invoice_delta_rate > 0.3% for 1h -> #billing-alerts.

kevin: rollback plan: pause reconciler, revert allowed_lateness, disable late_lane emissions. if needed run negative-compensation job.

marta: looping in @ledger-team for dedupe semantics on compensation_reference.

kevin: action items: kevin->shadow roll allowed_lateness, nisha->reconciler dry-run, marta->UI toggle, sam->canary + alerts, ops->monitor window, billing-bot->ensure dashboards. Will post follow-up after shadow run.
